Tests batch bytes extraction API (extract_batch)

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from xberg import extract_batch

async def main() -> None:
    inputs = [{"bytes": "pdf/fake_memo.pdf", "filename": "fake_memo.pdf", "kind": "bytes"}]
    result = await extract_batch(inputs)
    print(result.results[0].mime_type)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
